signs.aries: Physically restless and quick to recover; you begin things before you are ready and your health suffers most when you are sitting still.
signs.taurus: Solidly built and slow to tire; you resist being hurried into anything and need to be physically comfortable before you can concentrate.
signs.gemini: Wiry, quick and rarely still; your hands and your attention are always going, and you start far more than you finish.
signs.cancer: You feel new situations in your stomach before you have thought about them, and you approach them sideways rather than straight on.
signs.leo: Strong physical presence and a good deal of stamina; you throw yourself wholeheartedly at anything with your name attached to it.
signs.virgo: Finely tuned and easily thrown by small things; you notice every change in your own body and prepare before you commit to anything.
signs.libra: Even-featured and even-tempered; you enter new situations by finding out what is wanted, and you tire quickly in an atmosphere of conflict.
signs.scorpio: Considerable physical reserves held back until needed; you size a new situation up completely before you show any part of your hand.
signs.sagittarius: Long-limbed and hard to keep indoors; you plunge into new situations cheerfully and work out the consequences afterwards.
signs.capricorn: Durable rather than fast, and you wear well; you approach anything new as a project, and you were physically self-contained even as a child.
signs.aquarius: Nervy energy that arrives in bursts; you approach a new situation by working out how it functions before you decide whether to join in.
signs.pisces: Sensitive to everything around you and easily depleted; you drift into new situations rather than deciding on them, and you need recovery time afterwards.
